title: Huna Mar son of Rava of Parzika

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Ketubot 10a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.10a.13), where he posed a difficulty to Rav Ashi. Perhaps he is R"H son of Rava.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The identification with Rav Huna son of Rava is Hyman’s tentative suggestion.

The linked passage names Huna Mar son of Rava of Parzikya as the one addressing Rav Ashi. [Rav Ashi’s reply](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.10b.1) continues on 10b. Hyman tentatively compares an abbreviated Huna son of Rava, and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=985&lang=en) likewise treats the match as tentative.
